[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/23445/diffs?diff_id=1648052579&start_sha=07e1ce0c20a98a8bd7a42681d395f681cb0d5d55)

Making `metric_len` unsigned can turn this into an infinite loop if metric_len is odd.

https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/20999
Yes, I was a worried about cases like this, it is a useful property of signed values that you can detect when they go -ve...
Similarly this can be an issue if `metric_len` is an unexpected value.
